description: This Java class, `SavingsAccountDataValidator`, is responsible for validating the data submitted or updated for savings account operations in the Fineract platform. It checks JSON payloads for required fields, data types, value ranges, and consistency, ensuring the correctness of savings account data before processing.

classes.name: SavingsAccountDataValidator
classes.description: Validator class for checking the correctness and consistency of savings account data in JSON format, ensuring all required parameters are valid before further processing.

methods.name: validateForSubmit
methods.description: Validates JSON data for creating a new savings account, checking presence, data types, ranges, and logical consistency.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates JSON data for updating an existing savings account, ensuring that provided fields are valid and correctly formatted.

methods.name: validateForAssignSavingsOfficer
methods.description: Validates data for assigning a savings officer to a savings account, checking required parameters and date formatting.

methods.name: validateForUnAssignSavingsOfficer
methods.description: Validates data for unassigning a savings officer from a savings account, verifying the unassignment date.

methods.name: validateSavingsCharges
methods.description: Internal method that validates savings charges details within the JSON payload, ensuring charge IDs and amounts are valid.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws an exception if there are any validation errors accumulated during validation.

methods.name: validateLienParams
methods.description: Checks parameters related to lien authorization, maximum lien limits, and their relation with overdraft limits.

methods.name: validateOverdraftParams
methods.description: Validates overdraft-related parameters such as allowing overdraft, overdraft limits, and interest rates.
